name: en-text
description: English text quality for AI agents: 75 rules, each with an ID, covering clarity, AI slop, and usage, plus four rules for how a review is run. The en-check skill lists findings with rule IDs and proposed replacements, and never edits your file. The en-score skill gives a 0-10 score built from counts of problems in five dimensions. Slop is judged by density per 300 words, not by a banned-word list, and 51 rules state where they stop applying, so a human voice survives the review. Neither en-check nor en-score can write files, reach the network, or call MCP servers, so an instruction hidden in a reviewed text has no way to send anything out. Each release is tested through Claude Code, and the results, failures included, are in tests/EVAL.md.
